encodings.height: uint16 0..65535 -> normalized v/65535 -> metres v/65535*maxHeightMeters. PNG is big-endian (PNG spec), .r16 is little-endian.
encodings.splat0: RGBA8 = weights of classes 0,1,2,3; splat1: classes 4,5,6,7. Straight alpha (not premultiplied). Sum of 8 weights = 255 per pixel.
encodings.water: uint16 PNG. 0 = no lake/river water; v>=1 -> surface normalized (v-1)/65534, metres (v-1)/65534*maxHeightMeters. Ocean is NOT included: ocean = terrain height < seaLevel.

coordinates.pixelToWorld: pixel (i,j) centre -> x=(i+0.5)*cellSizeMeters, z=(j+0.5)*cellSizeMeters; normalized u=x/worldSizeMeters
